bounds: Database-backed mobile App Auth client registration; boolean presence in DB, enabled status, app active/approved authority, redirect URI matching, and legacy fallback behavior.
limitations: Covers database client registration resolution and authority checks. Low-level PKCE verifier hashing and cryptography are proven separately in repository tests.
Database presence is the primary authority; fallback configuration only engages when no client row exists in the database.
Disabled clients or unapproved apps in the database fail closed without fallback.
